description: Returns why CrawlCheck decided one finding: the rule and its revision, the fetches compared, when the condition held, and proof it is inside the signed record. Give a d1: or f1: id, a domain for its top finding, or domain plus code. Use to audit or dispute a finding. Fix plans exist in fix_robots, fix_entitymap, fix_mostly_code, fix_stale_cache and fix_machine_chain.

domain.description: Bare domain; alone it explains the top finding

id.description: d1: decision id, f1: finding id, or report id

name: explain_finding
title: Explain a finding
